test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Belly laugh

options.text: To be subjected to mockery and ridicule

solution:
The correct answer is A loud and unrestrained laugh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Belly laugh' is 'A loud and unrestrained laugh'.
 
• Belly laugh: a loud unrestrained laugh.
 
 
• *Example: her mutter of amusement blossomed into an enormous **belly laugh**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *A loud and unrestrained laugh.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__
